description:
The ported MATPRO Zircaloy correlations fit Young's modulus and shear modulus as
independent lines, so nu = E/(2G) - 1 crosses the incompressible limit of 0.5 at
T = 1354.84 K and reaches 0.912 at 1800 K -- the top of upstream's own stated
validity range. At 600 K a retained cold-work fraction above 0.1197 does the same.

Consequence: lambda = E*nu/((1+nu)(1-2nu)) is singular at the crossover and
sign-flipped beyond it, and mechanics::LinearElastic::new rejects such constants
outright, so a hot-Zircaloy case will fail where upstream would silently produce
a garbage stiffness.

This is a faithful port of a real upstream defect, not a porting bug. Upstream
neither detects nor guards it.

PoissonRatioModel::is_admissible() was added for exactly this. The mechanics
layer needs to gate on it -- decide the policy: clamp below 0.5, fall back to a
constant Poisson's ratio, or refuse the case with a clear error. Maintainer call.
title: offbeat: mechanics must gate on MATPRO Zircaloy Poisson exceeding 0.5 above ~1355 K

description: boolean.rs only supports convex-mesh Intersect (half-space clipping). Implement Union and Difference, and general non-convex/self-intersecting Intersect. Robust route: exact/filtered intersection predicates + surface arrangement + inside/outside classification (Manifold-style). Convexity rejection is currently a heuristic.
title: outram-blender: boolean Union/Difference + general non-convex Intersect
